privacy.checking: Checking the token and Privacy Mode…
privacy.ready: Privacy Mode is off. This bot can receive ordinary group messages.
privacy.privacyEnabled: Privacy Mode is still on. Disable it in @BotFather. Checking automatically.
privacy.invalid: Telegram rejected this token. Copy it again from @BotFather.
privacy.unreachable: AgentConnect could not reach Telegram. Try the check again.

findBot.label: Find the bot
findBot.caption: Search <name></name> in Telegram (the verified one) and open the chat.
findBot.impostors: Impostors are everywhere — take the verified one.

newBot.label: New bot
newBot.caption: Tap <start>Start</start> → <action>New bot</action>, then pick a name and a username ending in <handle>bot</handle>.
newBot.title: New bot
newBot.subtitle: Enter a name, description and username to create a new bot.

copyToken.label: Copy token
copyToken.caption: The bot’s screen shows the API token — copy it and paste it below.
copyToken.title: My Agent
copyToken.notice: Access the API using this token. Keep it secret.

guide.step1: Name and create the application. In Bot, reset and copy the token.
guide.tokenPlaceholder: Bot token from the Developer Portal

invite.scopes: — invites with the bot & applications.commands scopes and the right permissions.
invite.pasteFirst: Paste the bot token and an “Add to Discord” button appears — no need to build the invite URL by hand.

settings.inviteTitle: Invite this bot to a Discord server — preset scopes & permissions
settings.inviteLabel: Add this bot to a Discord server
settings.deleteNotice: The Discord application itself is not deleted.

newApp.label: New app
newApp.caption: <action>New Application</action> → name it, accept the developer terms, then Create.
newApp.terms: By clicking Create, you agree to the Discord Developer Terms of Service.

copyToken.label: Copy token
copyToken.caption: <action>Bot</action> → Reset Token, then copy it — Discord shows the token only once.
copyToken.title: Bot
copyToken.generated: A new token was generated! Copy it now — it won’t be shown again.

method.deeplinkHint: Recommended — approve in {brand}; permissions, events and credentials are connected automatically.
method.manualHint: Advanced — configure a self-built app yourself and paste its credentials.

deeplink.approveBody: We opened the authorization page in a new tab. Confirm the app and permissions; this dialog updates automatically.

manual.step1: Create a self-built app in the {brand} console, enable the bot, then copy its App ID and App Secret.
manual.step2: Paste the App ID & App Secret
manual.requestUrlHint: Connect here first, then save this Request URL in {brand}. It starts receiving as soon as the integration is connected.

sameOrg.title: Use the same organization
sameOrg.desc: Create every Bot App in the same Lark/Feishu organization as the App used to sign in to AgentConnect.

botCapability.title: Enable the bot capability
botCapability.desc: In the app’s “Add features”, turn on Bot — otherwise it can’t send or receive messages.

scopes.title: Grant message, contact and tenant scopes
scopes.desc: Request the message, chat and resource scopes, the two basic-contact read scopes, and tenant:tenant:readonly, then publish.

inviteBot.title: Add the bot to your group
inviteBot.desc: Invite the bot into the target chat — it replies wherever it’s a member and @-mentioned.

longConnection.title: Use Long Connection
longConnection.desc: Under Event Subscriptions, choose Long Connection and subscribe to im.message.receive_v1.

httpCallbacks.title: Use HTTP callbacks
httpCallbacks.desc: Connect here first, then add the Request URL shown above under Event Subscriptions and subscribe to im.message.receive_v1.

registration.denied: The Lark/Feishu app setup was cancelled.
registration.expired: This setup link expired — start again.
registration.agentUnavailable: This agent moved or was removed during setup. Check its daemon, then try again.
registration.invalidCredentials: The app was created, but its credentials could not be verified.
registration.orgMismatch: This app belongs to a different Lark/Feishu organization from this AgentConnect deployment. Create it in the same organization and try again.
registration.setupFailed: Lark/Feishu could not complete the app setup. Please try again.

settings.deleteNotice: The {brand} app itself is not deleted.

createApp.label: Create app
createApp.caption: In the {brand} developer console, create a <customApp>custom app</customApp> for your workspace.
createApp.title: Create app
createApp.note: Only usable inside your own organization — no review needed.

idSecret.label: ID & Secret
idSecret.caption: <credentials>Credentials & Basic Info</credentials> — copy the App ID and reveal the App Secret; both go in the fields below.
idSecret.masked: The secret is masked — reveal it once and store it safely.

setup.appRequired: Linear isn’t set up on this deployment yet. An administrator registers one Linear OAuth application for the whole deployment before workspaces can be connected.
setup.relayRequired: Linear delivers over HTTP callbacks only, so it needs a public callback endpoint. Ask an administrator to configure one, then connect a workspace here.

connect.connectedTitle: Workspace connected — <agent></agent> is its default agent.
connect.approveTab: Approve the workspace in the Linear tab.
connect.becomesDefault: <agent></agent> becomes the workspace’s default agent. You approve the workspace in a Linear popup.

picker.title: Pick the Linear workspace <agent></agent> works in.

card.notSetUp: Linear isn’t set up on this deployment.
card.approveTab: Approve the workspace in the Linear tab — this card updates once it lands.

settings.disconnectBody: <workspace></workspace> is removed for {audience}, and AgentConnect forgets its Linear grant. Delegations in that workspace stop reaching any agent. Connecting it again is a fresh authorization in Linear.
settings.disconnectFootnote: Disconnects the workspace for the whole organization.

builtin.approving: Approve the install in the Slack tab — this closes automatically once it lands.
builtin.installs: Installs the built-in AgentConnect Slack app.
builtin.useCustom: Use a custom bot identity instead

method.installLocked: Install in progress — “Start over” to switch method
method.configHint: Recommended — one-click install, no manifest to copy or tokens to paste.
method.botHint: Manual — copy our manifest into Slack, install, and paste the tokens back.

auto.readyHttp: App created & installed — click Connect to finish
auto.readySocket: App created & installed — bot token secured

approve.title: Approve the install in Slack
approve.body: We opened Slack in a new tab — click “Allow”, then come back. This updates automatically.

appToken.title: Generate the App-Level token & paste it
appToken.unavailable: (Slack has no API for this one)
appToken.locked: Unlocks once you approve the install in Slack.

scopes.title: Slack didn’t grant every permission this app needs
scopes.body: Reinstall the app in your Slack workspace to grant them, then click Connect again.

config.hint: Under <apps>Your apps</apps> → <tokens>configuration tokens</tokens>, generate a token pair for the workspace.

manifest.title: Create & install the Slack app from our manifest
manifest.hint: In Slack, choose <manifest>From a manifest</manifest>, paste, select a workspace, then create and install the app.

tokens.paste: Paste the tokens it gives you — required to connect
tokens.reinstallOnce: If Slack asks you to reinstall the app, do it once.

previews.pasteStep: Then paste the copied manifest, choose a workspace, and create the app.
previews.scrollHint: Scroll to the bottom of <apps>Your apps</apps> — the token pair lives under “App configuration tokens”.

settings.deleteNotice: The Slack app itself is not deleted.
settings.builtinRejected: Slack rejected this workspace authorization. Reinstall the app to reconnect it.
settings.joinPublicChannelsEnabled: When an agent reads or posts in a public channel this bot has not joined, the bot joins automatically and remains a member. Slack announces the join, and the membership applies to every agent using this bot. Private channels still require an invitation.
settings.joinPublicChannelsDisabled: Agents can only read and post in channels this bot has already joined.

replaceToken.title: Replace bot token
replaceToken.revoked: Reconnect with a new bot token

qq.step1: Create a bot in the QQ developer portal, turn on private and group messages, then copy its AppID and AppSecret.
qq.step1Warning: Before publishing the bot, add your daemon's public IP to its IP allowlist — QQ rejects calls from other addresses.
qq.step2: Paste the AppID & AppSecret — required to connect
